entries.zh: 调查恒星系
entries.en: Surveying a Solar System

entries.zh: §S调查§!其他恒星系即可有效地探索星海。在§S调查§!其他恒星系时，你可能会发现其他£planet£§S行星§!或是潜在§S资源§!。\n\n要调查恒星系，前往§S星系地图§!（£m£），选择一艘£science_ship£§S科研船§!，然后右键点击邻近的恒星系并选择“调查恒星系”。
entries.en: §SSurveying§! other solar systems is how you effectively explore the galaxy. While §SSurveying§! other systems you may discover other £planet£ §SPlanets§! and potential §SResources§!. \n\nTo survey a system, go to the §SGalaxy Map§! (£m£), select a £science_ship£ §SScience Ship§! and right-click on a nearby system and choose "Survey System".

entries.zh:
§Y1.§! 选择一艘科研船。
§Y2.§! 如果没有船上没有科学官，指派一名科学官。
§Y3.§! 右键点击指向邻近恒星系的箭头。
§Y4.§! 选择“调查恒星系”
entries.en:
§Y1.§! Select a Science Ship.
§Y2.§! Assign a Scientist to the ship if needed.
§Y3.§! Right-click on the arrow pointing to the systems nearby.
§Y4.§! Select "Survey System"

entries.zh: 前往科研船
entries.en: Go to a Science Ship

entries.zh: 研究异常现象
entries.en: Studying Anomalies

entries.zh: §S异常现象§!是你在§S调查§!其他恒星系时可能发现的奇异现象。研究异常现象基本（但不是全都）会为你的§S帝国§!带来有益事件。\n\n§S研究§!异常现象所需的时间取决于其难度等级和指派的§S科学官§!的技能。你可以使用左侧菜单中的§S情报日志§!（£f2£）来找到尚未调查的§S异常现象§!。
entries.en: §SAnomalies§! are curiosities that you may discover when §SSurveying§! other systems. Researching them generally (but not always) results in beneficial events for your §SEmpire§!. \n\nThe time it takes to §SResearch§! an anomaly depends on its difficulty rating and the skill of the assigned §SScientist§!. You can use the §SSituation Log§! (£f2£) in the left side menu to return to the §SAnomalies§! you have left unresearched.

entries.zh: §Y1.§! 调查周围的恒星系，找到异常现象。\n§Y2.§! 打开左侧导航面板中的情报日志。\n§Y3.§! 选择一个可用的异常现象，指派一名科学官对其进行研究。
entries.en: §Y1.§! Survey Systems around you to find Anomalies.\n§Y2.§! Open Situation Log in the left navigation panel.\n§Y3.§! Choose an available Anomaly and assign a Scientist to study it.

entries.zh: 打开情报日志
entries.en: Open Situation Log

entries.zh: 研究科技
entries.en: Researching Technologies

entries.zh:
科技划分为三个领域：
£physics£§S物理学§!、£society£§S社会学§!和£engineering£§S工程学§!。

你可以同时在每个领域中研究一项科技。
你的§S研究§!速度取决于你的帝国产出的§S研究点数§!，它由已殖民£planet£§S行星§!上的£building£§S建筑§!、£district£§S区划§!和我们所属恒星系中的§S研究站§!来产生。
entries.en:
Technologies are divided into one of 3 areas: 
£physics£ §SPhysics§!, £society£ §SSociety§!, and £engineering£ §SEngineering§!. 

You may research a technology in each area simultaneously. 
Your §SResearch§! speed is based on the amount of §SResearch§! your Empire generates, which is produced by £building£ §SBuildings§! and £district£ §SDistricts§! on colonized £planet£ §SPlanets§!, and by §SResearch Stations§! in owned star systems.

entries.zh: §Y1.§!在左侧导航面板中打开$topbar_button_technology_name$。\n§Y2.§!点击任何一个空白槽位，并从列表中选择一项科技开始研究。
entries.en: §Y1.§! Open $topbar_button_technology_name$ from the left navigation panel.\n§Y2.§! Click on any empty slot and select one technology from the list to start researching it.

entries.zh: 打开科技视图
entries.en: Open Technologies View

entries.zh: 利用恒星基地扩张
entries.en: Expanding using Starbases

entries.zh: 扩张帝国边境最有效的手段是建设§S恒星基地§!（哨站）。这项工作只能在已经被§S调查§!过的恒星系中进行。\n\n建立§S恒星基地§!需要命令一艘£construction_ship£§S工程船§!来执行相应操作。§S恒星基地§!建好之后，您就可以在这个星系内建设§S研究站§!和§S开采站§!，当然还可以殖民其中的宜居£planet£§S行星§!。
entries.en: The most effective way of expanding the borders of your Empire is through the construction of §SStarbases§! (Outposts). This can only be done in systems that have already been §SSurveyed§!. \n\nTo build a Starbase, order a £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ship§! to construct a §SStarbase§!. The presence of a §SStarbase§! allows for further construction of §SResearch Stations§! and §SMining Stations§!, as well as the colonization of any habitable £planet£ §SPlanets§! in the system.

entries.zh: §Y1.§!点击屏幕下方中央的按钮打开星系视图。\n§Y2.§!用屏幕左下角的按钮选择一艘工程船。\n§Y3.§!右键单击任何一个无归属的恒星系，点选“建设一座哨站”。
entries.en: §Y1.§! Open the Galaxy View by clicking the button in the central bottom part of the screen.\n§Y2.§! Choose a construction ship from the button in the left bottom part of the screen.\n§Y3.§! Right-click an unclaimed system and select "Build an outpost".

entries.zh: 前往一艘工程船
entries.en: Go to a Construction Ship

entries.zh: 殖民行星
entries.en: Colonizing Planets

entries.zh: 殖民其他行星可以让你的£pop£§S人口§!流动至新的行星，为你的§S帝国§!获取更多§S资源§!。有部分£planet£§S行星§!会有更高的宜居性，因此好好考虑在何处设立你的新£colony_ship£§S殖民地§!。\n\n殖民一颗宜居行星需要它坐落于你的帝国边境之内，并且被£science_ship£§S科研船§!调查过。
entries.en: Colonizing other planets allows your £pop£ §SPopulation§! to spread beyond its initial planet and gains you access to more §SResources§! for your §SEmpire§!. Some £planet£ §SPlanets§! are generally more habitable than others, so consider where you settle new £colony_ship£ §SColonies§!. \n\nTo colonize a habitable planet, it must reside within the borders of your Empire, and have been surveyed by a £science_ship£ §SScience ship§!.

entries.zh:
§Y1.§! 在总览（屏幕右侧）中选择您的船坞。
§Y2.§! 在船坞窗口的下方选择船坞选项卡。
§Y3.§! 建造一艘殖民船。
§Y4.§! 选择一颗宜居行星并点击“殖民”。
entries.en:
§Y1.§! Select your shipyard in the Outliner (right side of the screen).
§Y2.§! Select the Shipyard tab in the bottom of the Shipyard window.
§Y3.§! Build a Colony ship.
§Y4.§! Select a habitable planet and click "Colonize".

entries.zh: 前往一颗宜居行星
entries.en: Go to a Habitable Planet

entries.zh: 发掘考古遗址
entries.en: Excavating Archaeology Sites

entries.zh: £archaeology£§S考古遗址§!可以在§S调查§!的过程中，或是在一颗£planet£§S行星§!的殖民过程中被发现。\n\n当一个§S考古遗址§!处于一个§S帝国§!的境内时，该§S帝国§!可以派遣一艘£science_ship£§S科研船§!前往发掘。发掘的时长由§S考古遗址§!的难度决定。
entries.en: £archaeology£ §SArchaeological Sites§! can be discovered while §SSurveying§! or be uncovered after a £planet£ §SPlanet§! has been colonized. \n\nAs long as an §SArchaeological Site§! is within the borders of an §SEmpire§!, that §SEmpire§! can task a £science_ship£ §SScience Ship§! to excavate the site. The duration of an excavation is determined by the difficulty rating of the §SArchaeological Site§!.

entries.zh:
§Y1.§!在左侧导航面板打开情报日志。
§Y2.§!在情报日志书签中选择一个考古任务（以铲子插在土堆上作为图标）。
§Y3.§!使用“前往”按钮以移动到考古遗址。
§Y4.§!用屏幕左下角的按钮选择一艘科研船。
§Y5.§!右键点击铲子图标，并选择“发掘遗址”选项。
§Y6.§!选择一个考古遗址。
§Y7.§!开始任务。
entries.en:
§Y1.§! Open the Situation Log in the left navigation panel or press F2 button.
§Y2.§! In Situation Log bookmark choose one of the archaeology projects (Icon of shovel in soil heap).
§Y3.§! Use the "go to" button to move to the archaeological site.
§Y4.§! Choose a Science ship from the button in the left bottom part of the screen.
§Y5.§! Right-click on the shovel icon and choose "excavate site" option.
§Y6.§! Choose an Archeological site.
§Y7.§! Start the project.

entries.zh: 打开情报日志
entries.en: Open the Situation Log

entries.zh: 基础资源
entries.en: Basic Resources

entries.zh: 基础资源包含£energy£§S能量币§!、£minerals£§S矿物§!以及£food£§S食物§!。\n\n这些资源主要由您£planet£§S行星§!上的£building£§S建筑§!或者§S开采站§!产出。这些基础资源均以月为单位结算收获量和存储量，而且应当尽快搜寻和开发利用。
entries.en: Basic Resources involve £energy£ §SEnergy Credits§!, £minerals£ §SMinerals§! and £food£ §SFood§!. \n\nThese resources are produced primarily by the £building£ §SBuildings§! on your £planet£ §SPlanets§! or by §SMining Stations§!. The basic resources are all gathered and stockpiled on a monthly basis and ought to be quickly scouted, exploited, and developed.

entries.zh:
§Y1.§! 在屏幕右侧的总览中选择工程船。
§Y2.§! 打开星系视图（屏幕下方中央）。
§Y3.§! 选择一个已拥有的星系，右键单击。
§Y4.§! 点选建造开采站
entries.en:
§Y1.§! Select the Construction Ship in the Outliner (right side of the screen).
§Y2.§! Open the Galaxy View (bottom part of the screen).
§Y3.§! Choose a claimed system, and right-click it.
§Y4.§! Select Build Mining Stations

entries.zh: 高级资源
entries.en: Advanced Resources

entries.zh:
高级资源包括£alloys£§S合金§!和£consumer_goods£§S消费品§!。
它们是由£minerals£§S矿物§!经由在已殖民£planet£§S行星§!上的£building£§S建筑§!和£district£§S区划§!转化而来。

£alloys£§S合金§!具有军事用途，对舰船和恒星基地的建造至关重要。£consumer_goods£§S消费品§!则代表用于满足£pop£§S人口§!各种需求的小商品、奢侈品等物资。
entries.en:
Advanced Resources involve £alloys£ §SAlloys§! and £consumer_goods£ §SConsumer Goods§!. 
They are refined from £minerals£ §SMinerals§! by £building£ §SBuildings§! and £district£ §SDistricts§! on colonized £planet£ §SPlanets§!. 

 £alloys£ §SAlloys§! have a military application, which is needed to construct Ships and Starbases. £consumer_goods£ §SConsumer Goods§! represents the various gadgets, luxuries and goods necessary to keep your £pop£ §SPopulation§! content.

entries.zh: §Y1.§! 选择一颗行星（在屏幕右侧的总览）\n§Y2.§! 点击一处空闲的建筑槽。\n§Y3.§! 建造合金铸造厂。
entries.en: §Y1.§! Select a Planet (available in the Outliner on the right side of the screen).\n§Y2.§! Click on an empty Building Slot.\n§Y3.§! Build Alloy Foundries.

entries.zh: 概念资源
entries.en: Abstract Resources

entries.zh:
概念资源指代非物质性资产例如£influence£§S影响力§!和£unity£§S凝聚力§!。

£influence£§S影响力§!可以通过将其他帝国变为我们的§S宿敌§!或§S保护国§!来获得。影响力一般用于建设§S恒星基地§!或设立§S宣称§!扩张你的帝国边境，或可以用来执行§S法令§!。

£unity£§H凝聚力§!主要通过恒星上的建筑获取，并可以用于采纳新的§S传统§!。
entries.en:
Abstract Resources represent the non-physical assets of £influence£ §SInfluence§! and £unity£ §SUnity§!. 

£influence£ §SInfluence§! is earned by having other Empires as §SRivals§! or §SProtectorates§!. Influence is often spent on expanding your borders through §SStarbases§! and §SClaims§! or on enacting §SEdicts§!. 

£unity£ §HUnity§! is primarily gained from planetary buildings, and is used to adopt new §STraditions§!.

entries.zh: 战略资源
entries.en: Strategic Resources

entries.zh: 战略资源较为稀有，且在建造和维护高级建筑以及舰船部件时不可或缺。它们比基础资源更加难以获取，因此具有极高价值。天然的战略资源矿藏总是可见的，但需要特定的§S科技§!才能加以利用。
entries.en: Strategic Resources are rare and required to build and maintain advanced buildings and ship components. They are much harder to obtain than basic resources and are therefore also highly valued. Natural strategic resource deposits are always visible but require specific §STechnologies§! to exploit.

entries.zh: 贸易额
entries.en: Trade

entries.zh: £trade£§S贸易额§!由公民的日常经济活动产生。\n\n如果一座§S恒星基地§!通过§S贸易路线§!连接至您的£planet£§S首都行星§!，它将会以£energy£§S能量币§!、£consumer_goods£§S消费品§!或£unity£§S凝聚力§!的形式将星系内收集到的$r_trade$§S贸易额§!提供给你，具体形式视你的§S帝国§!采纳的贸易政策决定。
entries.en: £trade£ §STrade§! is derived from civilian day-to-day economic activity. \n\nIf connected to your £planet£ §SCapital Planet§! through a §STrade Route§!, the §SStarbase§! will provide the $r_trade$ §STrade§! of a system in the form of £energy£ §SEnergy Credits§!, £consumer_goods£ §SConsumer Goods§! or £unity£ §SUnity§!, based on the trade policy of the §SEmpire§!.

entries.zh: §Y1.§!点击屏幕下方中央的按钮打开星系视图。\n§Y2.§!用总览界面（屏幕右端）或左下角选项卡选择一艘工程船。\n§Y3.§!右键单击任何一个无归属的恒星系，点选“建设一座哨站”
entries.en: §Y1.§! Open Galaxy View by clicking the button in the central bottom part of the screen.\n§Y2.§! Select a Construction Ship in the Outliner (right side of the screen) or in bottom left tab.\n§Y3.§! Right-click an unclaimed system and select "Build an outpost".

entries.zh: 行星管理
entries.en: Planetary Management

entries.zh: 行星管理包括£district£§S区划建造§!、£building£§S建筑建设§!和£pop£§S人口§!的管理和增长，以及设立行星防卫部队。\n\n£planet£§S行星§!是一个星际§S帝国§!的重要组成部分，它们产出绝大部分的§S资源§!和£pop£§S人口§!，保障你的§S帝国§!繁荣发展。
entries.en: Planetary Management involves £district£ §SDistrict Creation§!, £building£ §SBuilding Construction§!, managing the £pop£ §SPopulation§! and its growth, as well as setting up garrisons for planetary defenses. \n\n£planet£ §SPlanets§! are a vital part of a galactic §SEmpire§! as they provide the overwhelming majority of §SResources§! and the £pop£ §SPopulation§! required for an §SEmpire§! to grow and prosper.

entries.zh: §Y1.§! 选择一颗行星（在屏幕右侧的总览）\n§Y2.§! 点击一处空闲的建筑槽。\n§Y3.§! 建造资源仓库。
entries.en: §Y1.§! Select a planet (available in the Outliner on the right side of the screen).\n§Y2.§! Click on an empty Building Slot.\n§Y3.§! Build Resource Silos.

entries.zh: 前往首都行星
entries.en: Go to Capital Planet

entries.zh: 建造舰船
entries.en: Constructing Ships

entries.zh:
所有舰船都要在拥有§S船坞模块§!的§S恒星基地§!进行建造和维修。舰船分为通用舰船和军用舰船。

通用舰船包括£science_ship£§S科研船§!、£construction_ship£§S工程船§!和
£colony_ship£§S殖民船§!。

§S军用舰船§!代表帝国所有的武装舰船，与通用舰船不同，它们可以被编组为§S舰队§!，并由一名§S舰队司令§!指挥。
entries.en:
All ships are constructed and repaired at §SStarbases§! where there is a §SShipyard Module§!. Ships are classified into utility and military vessels. 

Utility ships include £science_ship£ §SScience Ships§!, £construction_ship£ §SConstruction Ships§! and 
£colony_ship£ §SColony Ships§!. 

§SMilitary Ships§! represent all armed vessels of an Empire and unlike utility ships they can be grouped together into §SFleets§! that can be led by an §SAdmiral§!

entries.zh: §Y1.§! 在总览（屏幕右侧）中选择您的船坞。\n§Y2.§! 在船坞窗口的下方选择船坞选项卡。\n§Y3.§! 建造一艘科研船。
entries.en: §Y1.§! Select the Shipyard (available in the Outliner on the right side of the screen).\n§Y2.§! Click on the Shipyard tab.\n§Y3.§! Build a Science Ship.

entries.zh: 前往一座带有船坞的恒星基地
entries.en: Go to a Starbase with a Shipyard

entries.zh: 进行第一次接触
entries.en: Making First Contact

entries.zh: 当第一次遭遇新的外星物种时，特使需要完成一系列的任务。在这些任务中你的选择将会影响这些外星物种对你帝国的评价。
entries.en: When encountering a new alien species for the first time, a series of challenges must be completed by an envoy. How you choose to handle these challenges will influence their opinion of your Empire.

entries.zh: §Y1.§! 探索星系，发现另一个帝国。\n§Y2.§! 前往情报日志并点选接触事件。\n§Y3.§! 指派一名特使与其他帝国建立外交渠道。
entries.en: §Y1.§! Explore the galaxy until you encounter another Empire.\n§Y2.§! Go to the Situation Log and select the contact event.\n§Y3.§! Assign an envoy to establish diplomatic channels with the other Empire.

entries.zh: 打开外交界面
entries.en: Open Diplomacy View

entries.zh: 遭遇前超光速物种
entries.en: Encountering Pre-FTL Species

entries.zh: 有些文明还未发展出足以在星际空间旅行的必要§S科技§!。通过在他们的£planet£§S行星§!轨道上建立§S观测站§!你可以选择对其进行观测或研究，以获取£society£§S社会学研究§!增益。您还可以利用您优越的科技将其提升。\n\n提升后的物种将会成为提升他们的帝国的一份子，并给予500点£influence£§S影响力§!。
entries.en: Some civilizations have yet to develop the §STechnology§! necessary for interstellar space travel. By building an §SObservation Post§! that orbits their £planet£ §SPlanet§!, you may choose to observe and study them while gaining a boost to your £society£ §SSociety Research§!. Or you may choose to uplift them with your superior technology. \n\nUplifted species become part of the Empire that uplifted them and also grants 500 £influence£ §SInfluence§!.

entries.zh:
§Y1.§! 在屏幕右侧的总览中选择工程船。
§Y2.§! 打开星系视图（屏幕下方中央）。
§Y3.§! 选择一个已拥有的星系，右键单击。
§Y4.§! 点选建造观测站。
entries.en:
§Y1.§! Select the Construction Ship (available in the Outliner on the right side of the screen)
§Y2.§! Open the Galaxy View (bottom of the screen).
§Y3.§! Right-click on the system where a primitive species live.
§Y4.§! Select Build Observation Post.

entries.zh: 前往查看一个前超光速物种
entries.en: Go to a Pre-FTL Species

entries.zh: 指派特使
entries.en: Assigning Envoys

entries.zh: §S特使§!是可以被指派进行各种外交任务的低级领袖，他们可以改善您与其他£empire£§S帝国§!的关系，或与新发现的§S帝国§!建立联系。当指派一位§S特使§!进行某项任务时，一年之内无法再次调整其任务指派。\n\n§S特使§!在管理你的£empire£§S帝国§!在其他文明中的£opinion£§S评价§!方面非常重要。
entries.en: §SEnvoys§! are minor Leaders and can be assigned to various diplomatic tasks, such as improving your relationship with another £empire£ §SEmpire§! or establishing contact with newly discovered §SEmpires§!. Once an §SEnvoy§! is assigned to a task it cannot be reassigned again for a year. \n\n §SEnvoys§! are vital in managing the £opinion£ §SOpinion§! of your £empire£ §SEmpire§! among the other civilizations out there.

entries.zh:
§Y1.§! 在左侧导航面板点击通讯
§Y2.§! 选择一个您想提升关系的帝国。
§Y3.§! 点击外交。
§Y4.§! 点击提升关系。
entries.en:
§Y1.§! Click on Contacts in the left navigation panel.
§Y2.§! Select an Empire you want to improve relations with.
§Y3.§! Click on Diplomacy.
§Y4.§! Click on Improve Relations.

entries.zh: 获取情报
entries.en: Gathering Intel

entries.zh: §S情报§!可以用于削弱其他£empire£§S帝国§!或获取相对优势。一个帝国掌握其他帝国的情报量由§S情报§!资源来表示。\n\n您拥有关于另一个£empire£§S帝国§!的§S情报§!越多，您对其信息掌握的就越准确。
entries.en: §SIntelligence§! can be used to weaken or gain advantages over other £empire£ §SEmpires§!. The amount of information an Empire holds over another is represented by the §SIntel§! resource. \n\nThe more §SIntel§! you have on another £empire£ §SEmpire§!, the more accurate your information will be.

entries.zh:
§Y1.§! 在左侧导航面板点击通讯
§Y2.§! 选择一个你想了解更充分的帝国。
§Y3.§! 点击外交。
§Y4.§! 点击建立间谍网。
entries.en:
§Y1.§! Click on Contacts in the left navigation panel.
§Y2.§! Select an Empire you want to learn more about.
§Y3.§! Click on Diplomacy.
§Y4.§! Click on Build Spy Network.

entries.zh: 加入星海共同体
entries.en: Joining a Galactic Community

entries.zh: 已经接触了大多数其他星际文明的£empire£§S帝国§!会被邀请加入星海共同体。成为成员国后就可以在参议院中对新法律投票。投票通过的法律将于全部成员国施行。
entries.en: £empire£ §SEmpires§! that have met a majority of all other spacefaring civilizations will be invited to join the Galactic Community. Being a member allows them to vote on new laws in the senate. Laws that are passed will be enforced for all other members.

entries.zh: 所以自由就是这般消逝……\n……伴随着雷鸣般的掌声。
entries.en: So this is how liberty dies...\n...with thunderous applause.

entries.zh: 失落帝国
entries.en: Fallen Empires

entries.zh: 失落帝国是残存的远古星际势力。虽然已不复往昔，但是它们仍然持有着极其先进的科技。星际事务根本无法吸引它们，而它们也几乎不踏出自己的领域。
entries.en: Fallen Empires are the stagnant remnants of the galactic powers of old. Though mere shadows of what they once were, they still possess incredibly advanced technology. Galactic affairs are of little interest to them, and they rarely venture beyond their own space.

entries.zh: 采纳传统
entries.en: Adopting Traditions

entries.zh: 采纳§S传统§!需要花费£unity£§H凝聚力§!，可以让帝国专精于给定的方向，诸如军事与迅速扩张，或是外交及创建联邦。\n\n完成整支§S传统树§!后，£empire£§S帝国§!可以挑选一项§S飞升天赋§!来进一步强化自身。
entries.en: §STraditions§! are adopted using £unity£ §HUnity§! and allows an Empire to specialize in a given direction, such as military and rapid expansion, or diplomacy and creating federations. \n\nCompleting a §STradition Tree§! allows the £empire£ §SEmpire§! to pick an §SAscension Perk§! to further enhance itself.

entries.zh: §Y1.§! 打开左侧导航面板中的社会管理。\n§Y2.§! 选择一项传统进行采纳。
entries.en: §Y1.§! Open Society Management in the left navigation panel.\n§Y2.§! Select a Tradition to adopt.

entries.zh: 打开传统界面
entries.en: Open Traditions View

entries.zh: 设定政策
entries.en: Settling Policies

entries.zh: §S政策§!规定了我们的£empire£§S帝国§!在处理诸般事务时的态度：我国有多么激进好战，我国如何对待本国£pop£公民，以及哪些是我们可以接受的，而哪些不能。\n\n§S政策§!不同于§S法令§!，其无需花费代价就能实施，但会对其他帝国可能如何看待我们产生影响。
entries.en: §SPolicies§! define our £empire£ §SEmpire's§! attitude towards various matters: how aggressive our Empire is, how we treat our £pop£ citizens, what we view as acceptable and what isn't. \n\n§SPolicies§! are different from §SEdicts§! in that they cost nothing to implement, but have effects on how other Empires are likely to view us.

entries.zh: §Y1.§! 在左侧导航面板打开政策视图。\n§Y2.§! 点击外交姿态。\n§Y3.§! 选择合适的外交姿态。
entries.en: §Y1.§! Open Policies in the left navigation panel.\n§Y2.§! Click on Diplomatic stance.\n§Y3.§! Choose one that suits you.

entries.zh: 打开政策视图
entries.en: Open Policies View

entries.zh: 雇佣领袖
entries.en: Employing Leaders

entries.zh: §S领袖§!就是你的§S科学官§!，§S指挥官§!以及§S行政官§!。\n\n你最好指派领袖以率领§S军事舰队§!，管辖新殖民的£planet£§S行星§!以及指挥£science_ship£§S科研船§!进行探索任务。
entries.en: §SLeaders§! are your §SScientists§!, §SCommanders§!, and §SOfficials§!. \n\nYou are advised to have leaders for your §SMilitary Fleets§!, for governing your newly colonized £planet£ §SPlanet§! and for leading your £science_ship£ §SScience Ships§! that are sent on exploration missions.

entries.zh: §Y1.§! 在左侧导航面板打开领袖。\n§Y2.§! 招募一名科学官，以便之后指派其指挥新的科研船。
entries.en: §Y1.§! Open Leaders in the left navigation panel.\n§Y2.§! Recruit a Scientist that you can assign to a new science ship later.

entries.zh: 打开领袖界面
entries.en: Open Leaders View

entries.zh: 施行法令
entries.en: Enacting Edicts

entries.zh: 法令是一个帝国可以选择性实施的具有特定花费的帝国修正。新的法令必须通过研究或事件来解锁。持续性法令可以在任何时候花费影响力来激活或停用。
entries.en: Edicts are Empire modifiers with a fixed cost that an Empire may choose to apply. New edicts must be unlocked through research or events. Continuous edicts can be activated or deactivated anytime by spending Influence.

entries.zh: 保持人口幸福度
entries.en: Keeping a Population Happy

entries.zh:
开心的£pop£§S人口§!也是高产的£pop£§S人口§!。
但维持§S幸福度§!并不容易，如果让低幸福度持续，甚至可能造成§S不满§!。

幸好我们有许多方法来提升£planet£§S行星§!上的幸福度。行星§S政策§!和§S法令§!、§S国民理念§!、§S物种权利§!、§S建筑§!以及§S统治者特质§!均可以对§S幸福度§!产生正面影响。
entries.en:
A happy £pop£ §SPopulation§! is a productive £pop£ §SPopulation§!. 
But maintaining §SHappiness§! can be tricky, and if unhappiness is left unchecked, it can foster §SUnrest§!. 

Fortunately, there are many ways to improve happiness on a £planet£ §SPlanet§!. Planetary §SPolicies§! and §SEdicts§!, §SCivics§!, §SSpecies Rights§!, §SBuildings§!, and §SRuler Traits§! can all positively affect §SHappiness§!.

entries.zh: §Y1.§! 选择一颗行星（在屏幕右侧的总览）\n§Y2.§! 点击一处空闲的建筑槽。\n§Y3.§! 建造全息影像剧场。
entries.en: §Y1.§! Select a planet (available in the Outliner on the right side of the screen).\n§Y2.§! Click on an empty Building Slot.\n§Y3.§! Build Holo-Theatres.

entries.zh: 打开物种界面
entries.en: Open Species View

entries.zh: 管理派系
entries.en: Managing Factions

entries.zh: §H派系§!表示由相应思潮的§H人口§!所支持的政治团体。满足相应派系所提出的诉求可以提升他们的支持度和加入其中的所有人口的幸福度。幸福度高的派系将产出£unity£§H凝聚力§!。
entries.en: §HFactions§! represent political parties and are supported by §HPops§! with matching ethics. Fulfilling issues by a Faction will raise their Approval and the associated happiness of all Pops that has joined it. A happy faction will also generate £unity£ §HUnity§!.

entries.zh: 宣战
entries.en: Declaring War

entries.zh: £empire£§S帝国§!要开始一场§S战争§!需要战争理由，即向他国§S宣战§!的具体缘由。战争理由多种多样，可以是羞辱§S宿敌§!甚至是灭绝其他种族。\n\n§S战争§!有两种途径结束：其中一方§S投降§!，或经过协商达成§S维持现状§!和平。
entries.en: In order for an £empire£ §SEmpire§! to start a §SWar§!, it needs a Casus Belli - a reason to declare §SWar§!. A Casus Belli may range from merely humiliating a §SRival§! to exterminating another species. \n\n§SWars§! can end in two ways: With the §SSurrender§! of either side or with a negotiated §SStatus Quo§! peace.

entries.zh:
谨慎地选择您的敌人。
§Y1.§! 在左侧导航面板点击通讯。
§Y2.§! 选择一个您想进攻的帝国。
§Y3.§! 点击外交。
§Y4.§! 点击宣战。
entries.en:
Choose your enemy wisely. 
§Y1.§! Open Contacts in the left navigation panel.
§Y2.§! Select an Empire you want to attack.
§Y3.§! Open Diplomacy.
§Y4.§! Click on Declare War.

entries.zh: 打开外交界面
entries.en: Open Diplomacy View

entries.zh: 设置宣称
entries.en: Getting Claims

entries.zh: §S宣称§!会花费£influence£§S影响力§!，代表领土野心。\n\n在§S战争§!中，可以通过声索§S宣称§!，决定胜利者获得哪些§S恒星系§!。一国可以多次宣称相同的§S恒星系§!，获得更强的§S宣称§!程度，从而压过一同参与§S战争§!的§S盟友§!的宣称。
entries.en: §SClaims§! cost £influence£ §SInfluence§! and represent territorial ambitions. \n\nDuring a §SWar§!, §SClaims§! may be pressed to determine what §SSystems§! the victor will gain. It is possible to claim the same §SSystem§! multiple times to gain a stronger §SClaim§! on it, which can outbid the competing claims of §SAllies§! when going to §SWar§! together.

entries.zh: §Y1.§! 在左侧导航面板打开宣称。\n§Y2.§! 选择一个要宣称的星系。\n§Y3.§! 点击制造宣称。
entries.en: §Y1.§! Open Claims in the left navigation panel.\n§Y2.§! Choose a system to claim.\n§Y3.§! Click on Make Claim.

entries.zh: 切换至宣称地图模式
entries.en: Switch to the Claims Map Mode

entries.zh: 与敌方舰队作战
entries.en: Fighting Enemy Fleets

entries.zh: 想保护好你的£empire£§S帝国§!，一支强大的§S军用舰队§!是非常重要的。通过§S科研§!你可以获得更先进的军用§S科技§!来升级你的舰船，以及使你拥有维持更大§S舰队§!的能力。\n\n要想获得星际战役的胜利，要点在于熟知§S敌方配置§!，并采用相对应的§S克制手段§!。每一种进攻或防御性部件都有其反制方式。
entries.en: To defend your £empire£ §SEmpire§!, it is important to have strong §SMilitary Fleets§!. Better military §STechnologies§! can be gained through §SResearch§! that will allow you to upgrade your ships, as well as granting the capacity to maintain larger §SFleets§!.\n\nWinning battles across the stars is about adapting to the §SEnemy Loadout§! and using §SEffective Counters§!. Each offensive or defensive component has a countermeasure to it.

entries.zh: §Y1.§! 在左侧导航面板点击舰队管理器。\n§Y2.§! 点击“＋”按钮以增加您舰队舰船的数量。\n§Y3.§! 确保您每一支舰队都指派有一位对应的舰队司令。
entries.en: §Y1.§! Click on the Fleet Manager in the left navigation panel\n§Y2.§! Click on the "plus" button to increase the number of ships in your fleet.\n§Y3.§! Make sure you have an admiral assigned to every fleet you have.

entries.zh: 前往一支舰队
entries.en: Go to a Fleet

entries.zh: 保卫你的恒星系
entries.en: Defending Your Systems

entries.zh: §S恒星基地§!是恒星系中防御力量的核心。在关键位置的哨站可以被升级为§S星港§!，通过增加更多可以安置§S防御模块§!的槽位来提升其防御恒星系的能力。\n\n§S恒星基地§!自我保护的能力可以通过建设§S防御平台§!来提升。§S防御平台§!是一种可以围绕§S恒星基地§!部署的小型军用空间站，它可以作为武器的发射平台来使用。
entries.en: §SStarbases§! is your defensive cornerstones in your systems. Outposts in key locations can also be upgraded to §SStarports§! making it more capable in defending the system by giving it more slots for §SDefense Modules§!. \n\nThe self-defense capabilities of a §SStarbase§! can be reinforced with the construction of §SDefense Platforms§!. §SDefense Platforms§! are smaller military stations that are deployed around the §SStarbase§! and act as weapons platforms.

entries.zh: §Y1.§!点击任一座恒星基地。\n§Y2.§!选择防御选项卡。\n§Y3.§!建造一个防御平台。
entries.en: §Y1.§! Click on any Starbase.\n§Y2.§! Select Defense tab.\n§Y3.§! Build a Defense Platform.

entries.zh: 设计舰船
entries.en: Designing Ships

entries.zh: 默认情况下，舰船设计会自动生成、升级，但若想要对强大的敌人获得优势，你可能想要针对敌军的舰船作克制性的设计。护盾可以有效抵挡激光，但对导弹时形同虚设，而坚固的船体护甲面对炮火时则可以提供更好的防护，但对能量武器较为虚弱。
entries.en: By default, Ship Designs will be auto generated and updated, but to get the edge over tougher opponents you may want to create ship designs that counter the hostile fleet. Shields are tough against lasers, but vulnerable to missiles, while a strong hull protects against ballistics better than against energy weapons.

entries.zh: 终末危机
entries.en: End Game Crisis

entries.zh:
§S危机§!威胁到整个§S星系§!和其中的一切生命。

您通常不会独自面对§S危机§!。每当危机征服一颗£planet£§S行星§!，它就会对全体£empire£§S帝国§!产生外交§S威胁§!，使得他们更有可能合作起来对抗§S危机§!。

终末危机拥有§S情报日志§!（£f2£）条目，可以使您持续获悉双方的伤亡，以及显示距离§S危机§!被击败还有多远。
entries.en:
A §SCrisis§! threatens the entire §SGalaxy§! and all life within it. 

Rarely will you be ready to face a §SCrisis§! on your own. Each time a crisis conquers a £planet£ §SPlanet§! it causes diplomatic §SThreat§! with all £empire£ §SEmpires§!, making them more likely to cooperate against the §SCrisis§!. 

Endgame Crises have a §SSituation Log§! (£f2£) entry that keeps count of the casualties on both sides and shows how close the §SCrisis§! is to being defeated.

entries.zh: 暂时没有什么具体需要做的，但是随时做好准备。谁能知道天灾何时降临？
entries.en: No need to do anything about it right now, but be prepared. Who knows when the crisis will hit?
